title: hystrix elymoides
intro: Hystrix elymoides, commonly known as porcupine grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, contributing to its health benefits such as reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hystrix elymoides include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
